rows.label: Danube
rows.hook: flows through more countries than any other river in the world

rows.label: Nile
rows.hook: was the lifeline of an ancient civilization famous for pyramids

rows.label: Mississippi River
rows.description: primary river of the largest drainage basin in the United States
rows.hook: was central to a legendary era of steamboats and blues music

rows.label: Ganges
rows.hook: is considered sacred and holy by hundreds of millions of people

rows.label: Rhine
rows.description: river in Western Europe to the North Sea
rows.hook: is lined with medieval castles perched on dramatic cliffs

rows.label: Colorado River
rows.description: major river in the western United States and Mexico
rows.hook: carved out a famous mile-deep canyon over countless ages

rows.label: River Congo
rows.hook: flows through dense rainforest and is the deepest river in the world

rows.label: Yangtze River
rows.description: Longest river in Asia, and the third-longest in the world
rows.hook: is the longest river in Asia and home to a massive hydroelectric dam

rows.label: Yellow River
rows.hook: carries so much silt that it colors the sea where it empties

rows.label: Rio Grande
rows.description: river originating in Colorado, flowing south through New Mexico, and forming part of the US-Mexico border along Texas until emptying into the Gulf of Mexico
rows.hook: forms a long stretch of an international border in the desert southwest

rows.label: Ohio River
rows.description: river in the midwestern United States
rows.hook: was a major highway west for early American settlers

rows.label: Indus River
rows.hook: gave its name to an entire subcontinent and an ancient civilization

rows.label: Volga
rows.description: river in Russia; the longest river in Europe
rows.hook: is the longest river in Europe and a beloved subject of folk songs

rows.label: Missouri River
rows.description: major river in central United States
rows.hook: is the longest tributary river in its country, joining another mighty river near a major city

rows.label: Euphrates
rows.hook: was central to the rise of some of the earliest known cities and writing

rows.label: Brahmaputra River
rows.description: river in China, India, and Bangladesh
rows.hook: begins high on a plateau and floods vast farmland every year

rows.label: St. Lawrence River
rows.description: major river in eastern Canada and the United States, flowing into the Gulf of St. Lawrence
rows.hook: connects a chain of great lakes to the open ocean

rows.label: Columbia River
rows.description: river in North America; flows from British Columbia, through Washington, and along the Washington-Oregon border to the Pacific Ocean
rows.hook: is dammed for hydroelectric power and famous for its salmon runs

rows.label: Niger River
rows.hook: loops in a wide curve through the edge of a great desert

rows.label: Mekong River
rows.hook: supports floating markets and vast rice-growing communities across several countries

rows.label: Tigris
rows.description: river flowing from Turkey through Iraq and Syria
rows.hook: flows beside its sister river through the cradle of ancient civilization

rows.label: Elbe
rows.hook: flows past historic cities and was once a key trade route to the sea

rows.label: Narmada
rows.hook: is considered one of the holiest rivers, revered by pilgrims who circle its entire length

rows.label: Godavari River
rows.hook: is considered sacred and flows across a plateau to the sea

rows.label: Snake River
rows.description: major tributary of the Columbia River in the northwestern United States
rows.hook: carved a canyon deeper than the Grand Canyon in places

rows.label: Dnieper
rows.hook: flows south through the heart of Eastern Europe to a great sea

rows.label: Red River
rows.description: major river in the southern United States
rows.hook: winds through the southern plains, marking parts of state borders along the way

rows.label: Vistula
rows.hook: is the longest river in its country and flows past a historic old town

rows.label: Amu Darya
rows.hook: flows from towering mountains into a shrinking inland sea
